sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.notes: Primary automated source for photorealistic models, PBR textures and HDRIs. Live API requires a unique User-Agent and visible source attribution when integrated into a product/service.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.notes: Preferred second large CC0 reservoir. Automated ingestion intentionally disabled until an official current machine-readable API contract is documented and verified in-repo. Manual/index acquisition remains allowed after provenance capture.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.notes: Useful mobile-safe fallback/reference packs; style may be too simplified for final near-field realism.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.notes: Existing Arcont source for animation and nature/model packs. Acquire exact packs only with creator license/provenance snapshot.

sources.name: Sketchfab CC0-only candidates
sources.notes: No bulk ingestion. Every exact asset must pass per-item license, provenance and redistribution review.
